articles.title: Analyzing an Illegal Android Gambling App Built with Flutter

articles.title: Indian Oil to buy tankers as shipping costs soar
articles.summary: Indian Oil Corporation (IOC), India's largest state-owned oil refiner, plans to acquire its own crude oil and cooking gas tankers. This strategic decision aims to counter surging freight costs, largely driven by ongoing Middle East conflicts. Owning a fleet will enhance supply chain security, reduce reliance on external shippers, and ensure stable energy supplies for the nation amidst global geopolitical instability.

articles.title: Bill Cosby Accuser Says She Hasn’t Seen a DIME of Her $19.25 Million Judgement!
articles.summary: Disgraced comedian Bill Cosby faces potential jail time after Donna Motsinger, who won a $19.25 million sexual assault judgment against him, accused him of refusing to pay. Motsinger is asking a judge to compel payment, potentially leading to further legal repercussions for Cosby, whose prior sexual assault conviction was later overturned on a technicality, highlighting ongoing legal battles.
